content: Sneha Roy contacted insurance agent Anjali Desai to request a resend of her policy cancellation confirmation PDF, which was promptly provided via a download link. Sneha also inquired about any outstanding balances and was informed that her account is fully settled with no pending dues. Finally, she asked about reusing vehicle information for a future policy, and the agent confirmed that the same details can be used for a fresh quote later.

action_items: Customer to download the cancellation letter PDF via the provided link
